title: 第二十六章 碧云迷踪第二十七章 暗器
content_zh:
听着吴长老之言，秦凤鸣心中不由被其话语所吸引，如此神奇且不可思议的轻身功法，可是太过有违常理。
“请问吴长老，不知此功法现在何处，弟子倒想参悟一二。”
“此功法就在此庄院藏宝阁内，你可以自行去藏宝阁查看。
这里无人阻拦你。”
见秦凤鸣表现出如此兴趣，吴长老嘿嘿一笑道。
躬身施礼，秦凤鸣迫不及待的辞别对吴长老、转身便自向着庄院之中的那处藏宝阁走去。
当初来到此院落之时，秦凤鸣早已见到了那藏宝阁所在。
望着秦凤鸣匆匆而去的身影，吴长老不由轻笑了两声，低声私语道：
“又是一个不知天高地厚的小家伙。
那功法在藏宝阁已存留数百年，真正练成之人却寥寥无几。
如好学，也不会称为绝难功法了。”
不管吴长老如何想，秦凤鸣径直来到藏宝阁房门前，对站立两旁的紫杉大汉躬身一礼，恭敬说道：“师弟秦凤鸣，想去里面寻找一套功法，请两师兄行个方便。”
看看秦凤鸣，那两位大汉只是点点头，均未答言，也未加阻拦。
虽然不知此二人因何会毫无阻拦质问自己，但既然二人让自己进入，秦凤鸣自是毫不迟疑，双手推门，便自进入了藏宝阁内。
藏宝阁，内中十分宽大，足有数丈见方，正中间摆有五个书架，每个书架有上中下三格，每一格内却都摆放着数十上百本典籍。
目视如此多典籍，秦凤鸣心中大为惊喜，这些典籍，可比当初精英堂所见到的多上数倍不止。
走到第一个书架前，随手拿起一本书翻开一看，是一本玉女剑法心得，是一个名叫杜玉婷的女子所写，内容极其详细，可惜其对此剑法毫无涉猎。
一连拿起三本书籍，都是介绍武功心得体会的。
这些心得，如果被一修习相应武功之人见到，定然会兴奋非常，只需将这些典籍弄明，其自身武功，定然会大增不少无疑。
但此些心得，却非是秦凤鸣此次前来目的。

逐一查看各个书架，里面武功，内功，兵器等不一而足，均是世间已然失传的绝学。
但就是未见到那碧云迷踪功法所在。
直到秦凤鸣来到第四书架前，才自发现，此处正是轻功提纵方面的功法。
一连翻看数十本后，其才在最下层一角落出，找到写有《碧云迷踪》的书籍。
顾不得翻看，带着秘笈，秦凤鸣兴冲冲返回吴长老处。
见秦凤鸣高兴神情，吴长老自是知晓他必找到了那秘笈。
但对于那功法难练之事，其却并未再出言解说。
“多谢吴长老指点，弟子已在藏宝阁找到《碧云迷踪》功法秘笈。
不过，弟子这里还有一事要麻烦吴长老。”
“不知还有何事需要老夫帮忙，尽可直说。”
听闻面前少年此言，吴长老略有些诧异的问道。
其功法已然寻到，自是不会再找什么武功修习。
“弟子有些物品需找工匠制作，不知长老能否帮忙？”
秦凤鸣说着，手一番，自随身口袋里拿出一沓图纸。
正是其早就准备好的‘寒星’结构零件图纸。
然后恭敬的递到吴长老手中。
面露疑惑之色的接过图纸，吴长老凝神细看之下，知晓了此图纸用处。
不觉略一沉吟，立即又自点点头道：
“这是一份暗器图纸，如需制作，倒也不难，本门有专门制作兵器的匠人，且技艺非常高超，制作此种部件，当不在话下。
content_en:
Listening to Elder Wu's words, Qin Fengming couldn't help but be attracted by his words. Such a magical and incredible light body technique was too contrary to common sense.
"Excuse me, Elder Wu. I don't know where this technique is now. I would like to learn a little bit about it."
"This technique is in the Treasure Pavilion in this village courtyard. You can go to the Treasure Pavilion to check it out on your own.
No one is here to stop you. "
Seeing Qin Fengming showing such interest, Elder Wu chuckled.
Bowing and saluting, Qin Fengming couldn't wait to say goodbye to Elder Wu, turned around and walked towards the treasure pavilion in the courtyard.
When he first came to this courtyard, Qin Fengming had already seen the treasure pavilion.
Looking at Qin Fengming's hurried away figure, Elder Wu couldn't help but chuckle twice and whispered in a low voice:
“Another little guy who doesn’t know the heights of the world.
That technique has existed in the Treasure Pavilion for hundreds of years, but only a few people have actually mastered it.
If you are eager to learn, it will not be called a difficult skill. "
No matter what Elder Wu thought, Qin Fengming went straight to the door of the Treasure Pavilion, bowed to the big Yew men standing on both sides, and said respectfully: "Junior brother Qin Fengming wants to go inside to find a set of exercises. Please make it convenient for the two senior brothers."
Looking at Qin Fengming, the two big men just nodded, neither answered nor stopped him.
Although he didn't know why these two people questioned him without any obstruction, since they let him in, Qin Fengming did not hesitate, pushed the door open with both hands, and entered the treasure pavilion.
The Treasure Pavilion is very spacious inside, measuring several feet square. There are five bookshelves in the middle. Each bookshelf has three shelves: upper, middle and lower. Each shelf contains dozens or hundreds of classics.
Qin Fengming was greatly surprised when he saw so many classics. These classics were several times more than what the Elite Hall had seen before.
When I walked to the first bookshelf, I picked up a book and opened it. It was a book about the swordsmanship of Jade Girl. It was written by a woman named Du Yuting. The content was extremely detailed. Unfortunately, she had no experience in swordsmanship.
I picked up three books in a row, all of which introduced my martial arts experience.
If these insights are seen by a person who practices corresponding martial arts, he will definitely be very excited. As long as these classics are understood, his own martial arts will undoubtedly be greatly improved.
But these insights are not the purpose of Qin Fengming's visit this time.
Checking each bookshelf one by one, there are many kinds of martial arts, internal skills, weapons, etc., all of which are unique skills that have been lost in the world.
But I just haven't seen the location of the Biyun Lost Tracing Technique.
It wasn't until Qin Fengming came to the fourth bookshelf that he realized that this was the Qing Gong lifting technique.
After flipping through dozens of books, he came out of the bottom corner and found the book with "The Lost Traces of the Blue Cloud" written on it.
Not caring to look through it, Qin Fengming happily returned to Elder Wu with the secret book in hand.
Seeing Qin Fengming's happy expression, Elder Wu knew that he must have found the secret book.
However, he did not explain the difficulty of practicing the technique.
"Thank you to Elder Wu for your advice. This disciple has found the secret book of the "Blue Cloud Lost Traces" technique in the Treasure Pavilion.
However, the disciple still has something to trouble Elder Wu. "
"I don't know if there is anything else you need my help with, so feel free to tell me."
Hearing the words of the young man in front of him, Elder Wu asked with some surprise.
Now that he has found his skills, he will not look for any more martial arts to practice.
"The disciples need to find craftsmen to make some items. I wonder if the elders can help?"
As Qin Fengming spoke, he took out a stack of drawings from his pocket.
It was the blueprint of the structural parts of the ‘Hanxing’ that he had prepared a long time ago.
Then he handed it to Elder Wu respectfully.
Taking the blueprint with a puzzled look on his face, Elder Wu looked at it carefully and understood the purpose of this blueprint.
Unconsciously, he pondered for a moment, then nodded to himself and said:
"This is a hidden weapon blueprint. If you need to make it, it is not difficult. We have craftsmen who specialize in making weapons, and their skills are very high. It is not difficult to make this kind of weapon."Parts are a no-brainer.
